task.summary:
Exercises working with SQLite. the exercises are based on this video: https://youtu.be/tXJtY51xHq8?si=FnTO_19PSDt3Mn78
Learning implementation in python of: 1. Creating a new SQLite DB 2. Creating a new table in the DB with primary Key and unique indicators 3. Inserting a new entry in the table 4. Deleting entries 5. Updating an entry 6. Searching for ID, based on name 7. Continuous keyboard input loop
